title: Weekly rota table, templates and copy week
summary: Rota managers now build the week on a person-by-day table, edit shift templates, and copy a week to the next as a draft. Everyone else still only sees their own published shifts.

added: A person-by-day week table for rota managers, with an Open shifts row and overnight labels.
Add or change a shift from a table cell (from a template or as a one-off), including role and times.
Copy this week to the next as a new draft, without sending a publish email.
changed: Shift templates can be edited (name, role, day and times); retiring a template still leaves existing shifts in place.
Docs and tests confirm supervisors manage their own team's rota, and management and admin manage every team. Only rota managers see the full table.

internal_notes: Epic #518. Leaves #519, #520, #521, #522, #524. Approved leave still hard-blocks assignment; unavailability and double-booking stay as clash warnings. Stack remains Blade and small JavaScript; no Livewire.
